data.title: AUD8 Audio system rules: music modes, 3D mods, volume restore, inactive window

t01.t: RE gap (AUDIO.md 1.6, 8): exact visibility tests behind the 3D mute factor (object flags +0x3a2, +0x2a0) and who sets the SFX manager GUI-only flag +0x94 (port: pause menu) (backlog b0276)

t02.t: Mode shutdown does not reset the 3D saturation / rolloff mods to 1.0 (the front end uses the Galactic mods); same with vanilla data, differs for mods that change Audio_Galactic_3D_* (AUDIO.md 1.7) (backlog b0283)

t03.t: Music: mode 14 entries resume the previous music even without resume_previous (audio_system.cpp:1057), and MSS_Internal_Loop streams that report done are not restarted (AUDIO.md 2.1, 2.2) (backlog b0284)

t04.t: RE gap: music modes 9 / 10 (0x28f250) callers are the victory monitor 0x343b90 and battle-end dialog fill 0x88fe0, so they may be win / lose music rather than per-object music; the port only uses 16 (AUDIO.md 2.3) (backlog b0316)

t05.t: Lua Play_SFX_Event in galactic mode gets a stale battle position or the origin: object positions are fed only in battles and never cleared (backlog b0317)

t06.t: Space map terrain is forced to 7 for music and map ambience; AUDIO.md §9.1 suggests 0x364f00 keys map ambience by the raw TED mini 06, so _SPACE_PLANET_DATHOMIR_01 (raw 2, Desert) may get Desert ambience in retail. Check and split terrain_type() if so. Found in aud1 review. (backlog b0438, found in aud1)

t07.t: Master_Volume_Restore level after an options preview: GameAudioHost::set_volumes saves the master on every call, including the options dialog's PreviewAudio, so a previewed but not applied master is what Lua Master_Volume_Restore returns to until the next apply / load; retail's saver of the level is not traced (AUDIO.md 4 [M]) (backlog b0463, found in aud2)

t08.t: Inactive window: GUI / HUD SFX raised while the application is inactive still start (GameAudio::gui_sfx pumps the instance once) although step 14 does not run; retail likely queues them until reactivation (AUDIO.md 6.1) [guess] (backlog b0464, found in aud2)

t02.t: a2m: doc fixes: AI_GALACTIC_2 s2.3 and A2M_R2_RE_A s1.5 describe 0x401ba0 differently (the port follows RE-A s1.5), reconcile them; A2M_R3_RE_A s1.5 calls the vehicle-factory failure a Plan veto, the port shows a Budget-marshaller veto on Infrastructure A (recorded in PHASE4) (backlog b0129, found in a2m)

t03.t: bkg2 b0121 side finding (BKG1_RE_ANSWERS 10): retail's hostile-fleet-in-orbit test for the AI reads owner != player plus a fleet flag +0x94 [L]; the port's enemy_fleet_in_orbit tests hostility only. Check the flag and whether allied / neutral fleets count (backlog b0159, found in bkg2)

t04.t: Empire AI land skirmish (foc-land Utapau, --human Underworld --ai Empire, seeds 3 and 9 of 1-10, 36000, dev a8093abb skai-lane2): 1 Lua error each, BOBAFETTFLAMEINFANTRY 'GameObjectWrapper::Move_To -- Target is already dead' (object script orders a move onto a target that died the same frame). Check whether retail's Move_To raises on a dead target (LUA_API) or the port's script timing (target death before the script service) differs; the AI-vs-AI tests need 0 Lua errors. (backlog b0449, found in skai)

t05.t: Set_Difficulty (AI_GALACTIC 1.2, 0x4b0dc0) also rescales hard-point health by new / old Health_Multiplier; the port's live difficulty change (skm2 t01, CombatSystem::set_player_difficulty) rescales hull and shield only, because the port's hard-point maximum (hp_max) has no difficulty factor at spawn either. Check whether retail's hard-point max carries the AI health multiplier, then rescale both (backlog b0491, found in skm2)

t06.t: Staging screen default teams (gui_menus.cpp fill_skirmish_slots: slot 0 team 1, every other slot team 2) now decide alliances in a team-game skirmish (skm2 t02): opening slots 2.. without touching the team combos gives the human against allied AIs. Retail's default team of slots 2..7 (single-player staging 0xf1230 / 0xfe7c0; SKIRMISH_SETUP 2.8 has only the AI slot: local team XOR 1) is not read: re-question, then set the defaults (backlog b0493, found in skm2)

t07.t: Galactic AI IsConnectedTo / Nearby*Total attenuation: routed() (galactic_ai_tokens.cpp) counts the PlanetGraph's free-hop edges (planets within MaximumFleetMovementDistance) as routes, so every token neighbour scores d = 0 and the 1 - d/GC+0x108*A attenuation never applies. AI_GALACTIC_TOKENS §4: d = 0 only for a direct (trade) route (0x3f7b30). Check which edges 0x3f7b30 counts, then use trade routes only if so. Found by mcx5 t02's token test. (backlog b0514)

t01.t: bkt1 review leftovers (low): (a) attack_stage_goal tests samples against map_extents (whole terrain) but land_attack_order clamps the result to bounds() (playable box): a sample in the strip outside the playable box is clamped onto the edge without a zone / min-range re-check; (b) t05's self test treats a squadmate of a caller unit as self (attack_mover(id) == attack_mover(tu->id), battle_ai.cpp), BKT1_ATTACK_RE 3.1 excludes only the caller and its container; (c) after t03 the check loop's hidden / stealth test uses the centroid lead, land_attack_order's trim gate uses units.front() (FIGHTER_FLYING 4.11 E: members[0]); differs only in mixed formations with Target_Stealth_Units; (d) tier 3: map_extents rescans every terrain height per staging call (cache the box) (backlog b0169, found in bkt1)

t02.t: bkr2 Q6 (b0078, BKR2_RE_ANSWERS Q6 [H]): attack fire-trim gate (tactical_battle.cpp ~2037-2045) is the object hidden test (0x35f470 on the object, force 1), not a point test with force 0; a target both hidden and stealthed: retail tests hidden first, the port stealth first (backlog b0196, found in bkr2)

t03.t: bkr2 Q7 (b0080, BKR2_RE_ANSWERS Q7 [H]): slot leg v and dot test (attack_approach.cpp ~580-600) are 3-D with the literal first and last path segments in retail; the port uses non-zero 2-D segments (same on retail-shaped paths, a small slope effect remains). Also: the PHASE4 t25.2 '[port] lead's mask stands for the formation class' note is stale (the port now matches 0x4779e0 / plan class) and air-led formations' land branch is [L] (probe: two Snowspeeders onto a standing AT-ST 1000 away on open ground) (backlog b0199, found in bkr2)

t04.t: ShotEvent hardpoint / serial are not saved (combat_save.cpp writes shooter, target, target_owner): a projectile in flight at a load can play the parent's SFXEvent_Fire instead of the hardpoint's Fire_SFXEvent on the first post-load host tick. Found in aud1 review. (backlog b0439, found in aud1)

t05.t: FIRE_LOBBING_SUPERWEAPON (47) now passes Can_Activate (TRU1 t01), so a command 40/43 or Lua Activate_Ability for 47 reaches AbilitySystem's generic fallback (Unhandled event + recharge start, no shot); retail's route for 47 outside command 25 is not traced (TRU1_GRAVITY_FIELD 2) (backlog b0451, found in tru1)

t06.t: Gravity control field range test uses position() of every combat unit, so a garrisoned / transported affected unit still in the ability list can be slowed at its stale position; retail's field query (0x2a8fb0) walks the player's object tree [M: whether carried units are in it] (TRU1_GRAVITY_FIELD 1.5) (backlog b0452, found in tru1)

t07.t: SHIELDED regen gate (combat_system_part2.cpp shield_requires_base_power, cites 0x56bb00): TRU1_A RE identifies 0x56bb00 as BaseShield_Evaluate_State, so the SHIELDED Shield_Requires_Base_Power reading has lost its evidence; recheck its reader (inert in shipped data) (backlog b0454, found in tru1)

data.title: MOV3 Movement rule leftovers and movement test gaps

t01.t: bkm1: UseSecondaryFacing's snap of the body yaw to Y2 at the formation block pop 0x4105a0 (MOVEMENT 3.5.3 item 4) is not modelled: the port has no multi-block land formation. Also untraced [L]: a spawned unit's Y2 before / after its final facing (backlog b0165, found in bkm1)

t02.t: bkm1 review test gaps: no save round trip with non-zero LandMotion::end_z / yaw2 / Unit::lane_z or a UseSecondaryFacing unit; test_engagement_recruit covers only K(C) <= E(S) (not K(S) <= E(C), guard K = 0, the solo skip, the scan restart); no scenario for attack_plan's slot-leg z and its fire-trim interpolation; test_shield_class (c) is vacuous (p[0] on a shield cell) (backlog b0166, found in bkm1)

t03.t: bkm2 t07 (b0043) left: the rejoin generator rules (b) ends at the first failed path-length test, the ring resumes per goal, the 11-accepted-goal cap, an A* failure fails the call vs a pre-graph failure moving on) need a test accessor for MovementSystem::rejoin_search's candidate list (private); only rule (a)'s 10-step is covered indirectly (test_terrain_goal_relation +30 shift) (backlog b0174, found in bkm2)

t04.t: bkr2 Q4 (b0064, BKR2_RE_ANSWERS Q4 [H]): svs_pick_mover (movement_system.cpp ~4259): retail has no 'max speed 0 = immobile' rule; 0x686b20 gives such a unit cost 0, so it is picked first (ties to p1) and holds the record in state 1 without moving. Drop `!(walk_max_speed(x) > 0)` from imm (backlog b0191, found in bkr2)

t05.t: bkr2 Q1 (b0056, BKR2_RE_ANSWERS Q1): measurement, not a known difference: split MovementStats::corner_zero into corner 0 vs later corners and corridor-only vs line-test causes, and compare with the RE prediction (mostly corner 0: a standing neighbour on the first arc fails 0x5093c0 at every speed and Min_Speed defaults to 0 for 102 FoC land types; every fraction-0 corner not aligned within R is a stop and turn in place). Retail frequency would need an in-game trace of 0x61e930's branch to state 0xf (backlog b0192, found in bkr2)

t06.t: bkm3 t02 (b0094 b0054) left: the scene 'a squad container with a forced order and an exhausted push record coasting into impassable ground (the End Move coast reports)' cannot be reached through the public API (a pushed orderless container brakes along its push path and pops with 0 coast frames; an order mid-push ends the push) - needs a test accessor (set the push state or call team_walk). b0065 still has no case: every flag-1 Path Around caller is MvM (backlog b0202, found in bkm3)

t07.t: Begin_Turn_Towards_Distance (type +0x3a8; 22 FoC fighters / heroes, 100-900) has no known reader in docs/re or the port; likely shapes fighter turn-in (backlog b0398)

t08.t: Terrain height for the 0.5 under-water tests (Terrain::under_water: SurfaceFX surface, Destroy_When_Stunned_Over_Water) uses the port's triangle-linear sample_height; retail 0x135140 is read as a bilinear four-sample blend [M]. data.title: TST2 Test and harness gaps that serve tier-1 / tier-2 groups

t01.t: [test] ParityWorld in engine/ai/tests/test_ai_galactic.cpp passes an empty objects::GameObjectTypes whose raw() dereferences a null raw_, so a synthetic test plan that calls Find_All_Objects_Of_Type crashes the test exe (real runs load the types; a2m t03 used the take_selection_units hook instead) (backlog b0137, found in a2m)

t02.t: bkc1 t01 follow-up: headless story Esc injection (alamo_headless --story ... --story-esc-at <frame>: submit the kStoryEscSubtype command when StorySession::esc_goes_to_story() holds) so the UM01 retail run 20261108-234224 (Esc at battle frame ~128, STORY_T04_KESSEL_RUN 1) can be replayed headless; the run without Esc (20261109-053933) needs none (backlog b0143, found in bkc1)

t03.t: bkt1 test coverage (review 2026-11-12): covered today - t01 staging by test_land_attack_reach (min range 100: staged >= 130 from T), t02 by test_land_guard (re-plan within 31 frames, same slot), t05 by test_land_guard stage 5-6 (no-lock block kept), t06 by test_combat + test_movement_b5, t07 by the standin_owner predicate. Missing: t01 ring slide at map edge / cliff, search failure keeps T, the crush case, Activation_Min_Range picking M and the Activation_Max_Range engage clause (AbilitySystem::pending_ranges, CombatSystem::inside_min_range_of); t02 the Land_Guard_Range cap on R, the arrived re-check, the 40-unit drop for a hidden target; t03 a locked lead skipped and the all-locked wait; t07 a third-party unit idling on land; t06 with a staged G != C (backlog b0168, found in bkt1)

t04.t: Liveness set has no Walk_Transition unit or Destroyer Droid: add a FoC land skirmish seed or scenario with Empire walkers / Underworld droids to the six-seed liveness measurement (backlog b0047, found in s78n) -- bkm2: ctests alamo_headless_skirmish_ai_foc_land_empire_underworld_seed2 (AT_ST / AT_AA fielded when measured) / _seed4 (Destroyer droids) exist and end, but check only the battle end; left: have the run report the unit types fielded (or the distance walked per type) and check it; seeds 1 3 5-9 hit b0173 (backlog b0188, found in bkm2)

t05.t: bkx1 review: test_group_orders and test_prepare_ambush (alamo_ai_tactical_world_tests) run with the earlier [port] goal cadence (TacticalAiConfig::retail_cadence false): under the retail cadence the synthetic battle never reaches Attack_Target(Shield_Generator) and no Empire ambush instance sees its movers arrive before its report. Give both a retail-cadence scenario that reaches them (backlog b0210, found in bkx1)

t06.t: Test scenes missing after s78o: b0054 (a squad container with a forced order and an exhausted push record coasting into impassable ground: the End Move coast now reports), b0072 (an attack whose first path segment is zero, e.g. a lead standing on its cell centre: attack_slots now orders the ring by first_dir), b0065 (only once a non-MvM flag-1 Path Around exists) (backlog b0094, found in s78o) (backlog b0211, found in bkm3)

t07.t: gai3 t07 follow-up: evaluate the five Underworld infrastructure equations (Should_Build_Underworld_Barracks, Should_Underworld_Save_For_Desirable_Structures, Should_Save_For_Corruption, Needs_Groundbase_Upgrade, Should_Underworld_Build_Starbase) in the port on HotM seed 0 (human Empire) at the frames of docs/re/A2M_R3_RE_A.md section 7.2 and compare with retail's uw_infra.tsv (run 20261116-020754); agreement rules out the infrastructure ranking as a cause of the gai3 t03 spending gap (backlog b0441, found in gai3)

t08.t: alamo_game_smoke_saveload is not rerunnable: the run leaves [AutoSave].alsv in build-*/smoke_out/saveload_saves, the next run lists it first so smoke_main's campaign group stays collapsed and 'list shows smoke_main' fails (and the game bench tests that depend on it are Not Run). The test should remove its autosave too (seen 2026-11-17 in several trees) (backlog b0468, found in galab)

data.title: PORT1 Port feature follow-ups: fleet cohesion, fleet groups phases 2-3, fleet and ship names

t01.t: Fleet and ship names: show a fleet's name on the galaxy map (g_planet_fleet button tooltip or label; GalacticPlanetStack has no name yet) - port feature, docs/DECISIONS.md 'Fleet and ship names' (backlog b0252, found in names)

t02.t: Fleet and ship names: show a ship's name in tactical battles (selection panel / tooltip): the tactical object needs the galactic unit's name carried into the battle - port feature (backlog b0253, found in names)

t03.t: Fleet cohesion follow-up: a speed factor (ability, damaged engines) on one ship of a tight fleet does not slow the rest; the cap is fixed at the order (backlog b0254)

t04.t: Fleet cohesion follow-up: tight ships keep equal speed but do not wait for a slower-turning ship, so a fleet ordered to turn sharply can still lose its shape; add slot-keeping waits (backlog b0255)

t05.t: Fleet cohesion follow-up: a clickable HUD button for Loose / Tight (now hotkey O and a text line), and keeping the preference across sessions (now per session) (backlog b0256)

t06.t: Fleet groups phase 2: each fleet group as a framed run of portraits in the retail selected-unit bar (header tab with name, number, lock icon; tab click selects the group, portrait click selects that group's units of that type), world outline of locked groups, move-preview ghosts, rename / merge / split from the bar; plus an in-game option for the --fleet-groups switch (backlog b0260, found in fg1)

t07.t: Fleet groups phase 3: pre-grouped reinforcements (group in the reinforcement panel, made on spawn), join a group on arrival, auto-group the opening fleet by galactic fleet; open question: carry groups between battles on the galactic fleet (backlog b0261, found in fg1)
